chunks: And Ibn Mahbub narrated from ʿAbdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu ʿAbdillah عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a paternal brother and a grandfather. He said: "The property is equally between them."

key_terms.أَخٍ لِأَبٍ: a brother related through the father only

ai.seo_question: How is the inheritance divided between a paternal brother and a grandfather in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling in inheritance concerning a paternal brother and a grandfather. The Imam عليه السلام states that the estate is divided equally between the two, indicating parity in this specific case.
